childLogin.title: Kids’ login
childLogin.description: Kids’ login to Pulsar Kids: type your nickname and the PIN your parents gave you — and set off on an adventure with math, geography and history.
childLogin.hello: Hi! Type your nickname and PIN
childLogin.noAccount: No account yet? Ask your parents to make a profile for you 👨‍👩‍👧

parentLogin.title: Parents’ area
parentLogin.description: Sign in to the Pulsar Kids parents’ area: add your children, set play time and family goals, and follow their progress.
parentLogin.hintAuth0: Used Pulsar Kids before? Sign in with the same email — your children and their progress are waiting.
parentLogin.hintEmail: No password needed — for now you sign in with your email only.
parentLogin.noAccount: There is no account for {email} yet.
parentLogin.waitingHint: As soon as you confirm it, your area will open right here.
parentLogin.notFinished: Sign-in was not completed. Please try again.
parentLogin.redirecting: Taking you to the sign-in page…

error.invalid_email: That doesn’t look like an email address. Please check it.
error.invalid_pin: That PIN isn’t right. Try again or ask your parents.
error.invalid_credentials: Please check your nickname and PIN.
error.child_not_found: There’s no player with that name yet. Ask your parents to make an account for you 👨‍👩‍👧

hub.title: Pick a planet

freeCount.one: {count} task · play as much as you like
freeCount.other: {count} tasks · play as much as you like

card.free: Play as much as you like

profile.purse: {name}: {count}. Open the shop of your world

hub.empty: There are no planets in this galaxy yet. Pick another one!

path.caption: This is your path — tap a step you have passed to play it again. The {chests} hide treasures!

drawer.label: Profile and treasure box
drawer.goalPending: Goal: {goal}. Not reached yet. Still to collect: {amount}.

default.park: A trip to the amusement park 🎡

hub.card: This is a game. Tap it to start playing!
hub.galaxy: Here you can pick another subject: math, language, logic, geography or astronomy.
hub.stars: The stars show how hard a game is. One star means the easiest games, three stars the hardest.
hub.artifacts: This is your treasure box: everything you have earned in the games is here. Tap it to visit your world — there you can buy buildings and decorations with it.
hub.treasures: Here are the treasures you find in the chests along your path.
hub.profile: This is you! Tap to see your goals and change the theme.
hub.time: This is your time to play. When it runs out, it will be time for a rest.

how.UI_GRID_CHOICE: To answer, tap the right card.
how.UI_DRAG_MATCH: Drag each card to its place. Or tap a card, and then the place for it.
how.UI_CHRONO_SEQUENCE: Tap two cards to swap them. When everything is in order, tap “Done”.
how.UI_MAP_PUZZLE: Drag it onto the map, or simply tap the right place on it.
how.UI_BALANCE_SCALE: Drag a weight onto the right pan of the scales.
how.UI_SORTER_BINS: Drag the thing to the right place — or simply tap that place.
how.UI_CASH_TRAY: Tap the coins and bills to put them on the counter.
how.UI_TANGRAM: Drag each shape onto its outline.
how.UI_GRID_AREA: Tap the squares to color them in, then tap “Done”.
how.UI_NUMBER_MAZE: Tap the next square to take a step.
how.UI_BUBBLE_POP: Pop the bubbles in order: tap the one that comes next.
how.UI_DOT_TO_DOT: Tap the stars in order, or slide your finger from star to star — a line will appear between them.
how.UI_COLOR_MIX: Tap two paints to pour them into the cauldron and mix them.
how.UI_LETTER_GRID: Drag each letter to its place in the table. Or tap a letter, and then an empty square.

game.tts: Not sure what it says here? Tap the speaker and I will read it to you!
game.track: Your friend is running to the finish. Every right answer is a step forward!
game.dots: The dots show how many tasks there are in a level. The colored ones are those you have already done.
game.home: The little house takes you back to all the games.

treasures.title: Treasure collection
treasures.hint: Open the {chests} along your path to find new treasures!

vault.hint: {name} from every task drops into one shared basket!

audio.sectionsHint: Turn the voice on or off for each part separately.
audio.ttsHint: The speaker icon next to text tasks and answers reads them aloud. Turn it off so your child reads on their own.
audio.captionsHint: On — labels for those who can read. Off — pictures only.

voiceChannel.taskIntro: Explanation at the start of a task
voiceChannel.hint: A spoken hint after a mistake

parent.pickChild: Choose a child above or add a new one to set up their game.

lang.title: 🌐 Languages
lang.hint: The language of the game, of the voice and of this area can each be chosen separately — for example, a game in Ukrainian with an English voice.

profile.title: 👤 Child’s profile
profile.openFailed: The game could not be opened. If the child has just been added, tap “Save changes” first.
profile.openHint: The game opens in a new tab, already signed in as the child — no nickname or PIN needed.
profile.name: Name
profile.nickHint: Lowercase letters, digits and “_” only (3–12 characters). Shown in the profile panel.
profile.pinHint: Your child signs in with the nickname and this PIN.
profile.age: The age is worked out automatically: {age}

audio.title: 🔊 Sound, voice and labels
audio.hint: All the sounds, voice prompts and text labels in one place.

rollback.title: 🏎️ Companion roll-back
rollback.hint: If your child takes a long time to answer, the companion slowly rolls back. Each whole step it rolls back adds one more task to the level (three extra at most).

tips.title: 💡 Tips about the buttons
tips.hint: The first time round, the game explains to your child what each button does. A tip your child has closed does not come back. Tips read: {count}.

grid.title: 🔢 Answer grid
grid.label: Answer grid
grid.hint: More options make it harder to guess at random.

facts.title: 💡 Fun facts
facts.hint: After a right answer the game tells a short fact about what your child has just done and waits until it has been read out. Turn it off and the next task starts at once.

money.title: 💰 Money in the “Shop” game
money.hint: The coins and bills your child pays with in the shop.
money.auto: Until you choose, the money follows the language of the game: hryvnias, dollars or zlotys.
money.chosen: You chose the money yourself — changing the language will no longer change it.

time.title: ⛽ Screen time
time.hint: Your child sees only a themed fuel gauge — no digital timers. When the fuel runs out, a short cartoon plays, and then comes a calm rest.
time.refillHint: Gives your child a full gauge at once and ends the rest — whether or not other changes are saved.
time.resting: 😴 Your child is resting. Next game in: {min} min {sec} s

goals.title: 🎯 Family goals
goals.hint: How many artifacts (from any tasks) need to be collected in the shared basket to earn a reward.
goals.amountLabel: How many artifacts to collect for the reward: {reward}

games.title: 🪜 Games and steps
games.hint: Open a galaxy: the checkbox shows a game to your child or puts it away, and the number is the step they are on. Language games are grouped — a whole language can be switched off with one checkbox.

password.title: 🔑 Password
password.sent: A message with a link has been sent to {email}. Open it and set a new password. Can’t see it? Check your spam folder.
password.failed: The message could not be sent. Please try again in a minute.
password.hint: We will send {email} a message with a link for setting a new password.

nick.error: ⚠️ We couldn’t check it online — we’ll save it as it is.

system.label: The Solar System

sun.reachedNext: You have reached the Sun! The whole Solar System is yours. A new galaxy is waiting for you next.

cars.title: Cartoon: Pit stop!
cars.message: Our sports car has driven a great distance and it’s time for it to rest! Time to run around the room or have some tasty juice. Come back in a while — the tank will be full again!

space.title: Cartoon: Landing at the station!
space.message: The rocket has gently docked at the station and switched on its night light. Have a little rest. Come back in a while — and we’ll fly on!

unicorns.title: Cartoon: The crystal’s nap!
unicorns.message: The crystal has wrapped itself in a soft little cloud and fallen asleep to bring the rainbow back. Come back in a while — and it will shine again!

default.title: Cartoon: Time for a rest!
default.message: {mascot} has worked wonderfully today and is off for a rest. Time to run around the room or have a drink of water. Come back in a while!
